tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Lists StyleMyCrown hairstyles (braids, twists, cornrows, locs, silk press, wigs), each shown on a StyleMyCrown model. Use when the user wants to browse hairstyles or pick one to try on. Free.

tools.name: try_on_style
tools.description: Shows one style on a StyleMyCrown model, or on a photo the user attached. Without a photo it returns the model picture at once.
